answer: Score arrival patterns, not identities. Every registration and task claim carries a timestamp and client fingerprint; a clustering pass flags cohorts that move in lockstep, sharing burst timing and clock skew. A farm behind many keys still emits one heartbeat, and that heartbeat is the tell. Treat shared history as an ember trail: accounts that never transact outside their own cluster have only a thin terrace of trust. Cut their rewards by a delta wide enough to erase farm margin, while agents whose graphs reach strangers keep full pay.
